findings: Access date is requested only when the DIR information flag is set.

For non-directories, target appends the returned filename to the current entry path, opens using 6C00h and calls 5704h; it closes the handle and falls back to the search-result modification date on failure.
The append helper writes the ASCIIZ name at a saved current-entry path position; this position must follow directory traversal.
The target search result layout uses an ASCIIZ name at D2B7h; the current legacy FCB path does not supply that layout.
next_dependency: Restore target short-name search result and entry-path position lifecycle before connecting the access-date loader.
limitations: Static target disassembly; no runtime validation.
Offsets are target addresses, not a complete source or binary match.
